description: A dashboard to expose libvirt Metrics and Project Overview

panels.title: VMs by memory used %
panels.description: Guest memory in use as a share of the VM's memory: 1 - usable / maximum, where usable is the guest's MemAvailable from the balloon driver. VMs without balloon stats are not listed.

panels.title: RX/TX Packets Per Sec on VMs

panels.description: 100% = 1 Thread
panels.title: vCPU Usage on VM

panels.description: Protocol rbd = Ceph; disk type block = iSCSI (Pure). Volume ID is empty for ephemeral disks. Provisioned falls back to the Cinder volume size where the libvirt exporter has no capacity metric (older exporter versions).
panels.title: Disks

targets.expr: max by (target_device, serial, source_protocol, disk_type, driver_cache, driver_discard, target_bus, compute) (libvirt_domain_block_stats_info{os_region="$cluster",domain=~"$domain",target_device=~"$disk"})

max by (target_device) (libvirt_domain_block_stats_capacity_bytes{os_region="$cluster",domain=~"$domain",target_device=~"$disk"}) or max by (target_device) (label_replace(libvirt_domain_block_stats_info{os_region="$cluster",domain=~"$domain",target_device=~"$disk",serial!=""}, "id", "$1", "serial", "(.*)") * on (id) group_left () max by (id) (openstack_cinder_volume_gb{os_region="$cluster"})) * 1073741824

topk(10, rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_bytes_total{target_device=~"$disk",domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(domain) group_left(flavor,instance_name,project_name,user_name) (libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"} or libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"})) or on() vector(0)

topk(10, rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_bytes_total{target_device=~"$disk",domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval]) * on(domain) group_left(flavor,instance_name,project_name,user_name) (libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"} or libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"})) or on() vector(0)

panels.description: Average time per write request as the guest sees it (libvirt), per disk.

targets.expr:
topk(20,
  rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_time_seconds_total{target_device=~"$disk",domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval])
  / rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_write_requests_total{target_device=~"$disk",domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval])
  * on(domain) group_left(instance_name) max by (domain, instance_name) (libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"})
)

panels.title: Write latency

panels.description: Average time per read request as the guest sees it (libvirt), per disk.

targets.expr:
topk(20,
  rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_time_seconds_total{target_device=~"$disk",domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval])
  / rate(libvirt_domain_block_stats_read_requests_total{target_device=~"$disk",domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"}[$__rate_interval])
  * on(domain) group_left(instance_name) max by (domain, instance_name) (libvirt_domain_openstack_info{domain=~"$domain",job=~"libvirt_exporter",compute=~"$compute"})
)

panels.title: Read latency

panels.description: Provisioned from QEMU. Used from the backend: Ceph rbd du or Pure total_physical (after data reduction), joined through the Cinder volume ID.
panels.title: Capacity

targets.expr: max by (target_device) (libvirt_domain_block_stats_capacity_bytes{os_region="$cluster",domain=~"$domain",target_device=~"$disk"}) or max by (target_device) (label_replace(libvirt_domain_block_stats_info{os_region="$cluster",domain=~"$domain",target_device=~"$disk",serial!=""}, "id", "$1", "serial", "(.*)") * on (id) group_left () max by (id) (openstack_cinder_volume_gb{os_region="$cluster"})) * 1073741824

max by (target_device) (ceph_rbd_image_used_bytes{os_region="$cluster"} * on (image) group_left (uuid) label_replace(max by (uuid, backend_name) (openstack_volume_metadata{os_region="$cluster"}), "image", "$1", "backend_name", "(.*)") * on (uuid) group_left (target_device) label_replace(max by (serial, target_device) (libvirt_domain_block_stats_info{os_region="$cluster",domain=~"$domain",target_device=~"$disk"}), "uuid", "$1", "serial", "(.*)"))

max by (target_device) (purefa_volume_space_bytes{os_region="$cluster",space="total_physical"} * on (name) group_left (uuid) label_replace(max by (uuid, backend_name) (openstack_volume_metadata{os_region="$cluster"}), "name", "$1", "backend_name", "(.*)") * on (uuid) group_left (target_device) label_replace(max by (serial, target_device) (libvirt_domain_block_stats_info{os_region="$cluster",domain=~"$domain",target_device=~"$disk"}), "uuid", "$1", "serial", "(.*)"))
max by (display_name, volume_type, host, backend_name, uuid, project_id) (openstack_volume_metadata{os_region="$cluster",uuid="$volume"})

panels.description: Volume size: RBD image size (rbd du, every 5 minutes) or the Pure volume's provisioned size.
panels.title: Provisioned

panels.description: Ceph: space the image uses, snapshots excluded (rbd du, every 5 minutes). Pure: data the host has written (virtual), before data reduction.
panels.title: Used

panels.description: Used (Ceph) or written (Pure) as a share of the provisioned size.
panels.title: Used %

panels.description: Per-volume operations from the Ceph mgr prometheus module (rbd_stats_pools) or the Pure FlashArray exporter.
panels.title: IOPS

panels.description: Latency per operation as the backend sees it (librbd for Ceph, the array for Pure). Pure QoS wait is the time held back by the volume's QoS limit. Compare with the guest view above, which includes the hypervisor and the network.
panels.title: Average latency

targets.expr: max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_read_latency_sum{cluster_name="$ceph_cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval])) / max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_read_latency_count{cluster_name="$ceph_cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval]))

max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_write_latency_sum{cluster_name="$ceph_cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval])) / max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_write_latency_count{cluster_name="$ceph_cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval]))

max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_read_bytes{cluster_name="$ceph_cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval])) / max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_read_ops{cluster_name="$ceph_cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval]))

max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_write_bytes{cluster_name="$ceph_cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval])) / max without (instance, job) (rate(ceph_rbd_write_ops{cluster_name="$ceph_cluster",pool="$pool",image="$image"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.description: Ceph: rbd du, every 5 minutes. Pure: written is before data reduction; physical is after deduplication and compression, snapshots included.
